message:
I’ll never forget the day I finally felt like the prepared one in my family. It was during a winter storm warning, and while everyone else was panicking about snow shovels and milk, I had a cozy little stash of snacks, blankets, and even a few candles ready to go. I felt like a superhero in my fuzzy slippers! 

As the snow piled up outside, my grandkids and I built a fort in the living room, complete with my emergency flashlight as our ‘campfire.’ It turned into one of those unexpected family bonding moments that I wouldn’t trade for all the milk in the world. 

So, here’s a thought: maybe it’s not just about having supplies, but also about making memories while we prepare. What’s your favorite tip for turning a potential storm into a fun family adventure? 🌨️
